question: Does the "三维山水全景地图" 3D panorama map need to be reproduced, or is the offline Feng Shui compass + knowledge base the intended core?
probes: core_person_ask about scope: 3D live map vs offline compass core
resolution: Decided to build the offline Feng Shui compass + knowledge base as the core. The 3D panorama map requires AMap online service + a 3D terrain engine (libterrain.so) and cannot run offline in a self-contained desktop app; the person delegated decisions, and this is the closest reproducible equivalent. A heading-reading panel reproduces the compass's practical output.
